kalk.p1: Basel tap water ranks among the hardest in German-speaking Switzerland – with a limescale content of up to 35 French hardness degrees. This means: without professional care, stubborn limescale stains form on fixtures, showers, glass surfaces and kitchen appliances that are almost impossible to remove with ordinary household products.
kalk.p2: D'Namar has specialised in exactly this problem since 2015. We use tested limescale removers and protective sealants developed specifically for hard water – gentle on surfaces, effective against deposits. After each cleaning, we can apply a limescale protection film to glass, chrome and natural stone surfaces that keeps new deposits away for up to 8 weeks.
kalk.p3: Whether a shower cabin in Gundeldingen, a stainless steel kitchen in Riehen or a glass front in a Basel commercial property – our team knows the right method for every surface and every level of limescale.

manifest.p1: It all began with a simple idea: cleaning should not be an anonymous service – but a personal promise. Maritza Rodriguez and Nadjib Rasuly founded D'Namar with the goal of giving Basel households and businesses exactly what many large companies cannot offer: reliability with a human face.
manifest.p2: Basel is our home. We know the buildings, the property managers and the high standards of Basel's tenants and owners. We know what the hard Basel limescale does to fixtures, showers and glass surfaces – and we have the right products and expertise to remove it gently and effectively.

datenschutz.title: Privacy Policy
datenschutz.subtitle: As of August 2025
datenschutz.personal_data_intro: When you access this website, general information is automatically collected. This information is recorded in server log files and includes the type of web browser used, the operating system, the domain name of your internet service provider, your IP address, and similar data.
datenschutz.personal_data_reasons_title: This is done for the following reasons:
datenschutz.personal_data_reason1: To ensure a smooth connection to the website
datenschutz.personal_data_reason2: To ensure smooth use of our website
datenschutz.personal_data_reason3: Evaluation of system security and stability
datenschutz.personal_data_note: Your data will not be used to draw conclusions about your identity. Information of this type is only evaluated statistically to optimise our website and the underlying technology.
datenschutz.storage_text: Data is deleted as soon as it is no longer required for the purpose for which it was collected. For data used to provide the website, this is generally the case when the respective session has ended.
datenschutz.contact_form_text: The data you enter is stored for the purpose of individual communication with you. This requires a valid e-mail address and your name. These are used to assign the request and respond to it. Additional information is optional.

datenschutz.maps_more: More information about data processing by Google can be found in Google's privacy notices, where you can also change your personal privacy settings in the Privacy Center.
datenschutz.rights_text: If you have an account on this website or have submitted reviews, you may request an export of your personal data, including all data you have provided to us. You may also request the deletion of all personal data we hold about you. This does not include data we are required to retain for administrative, legal, or security reasons.

datenschutz.changes_text: We may update this privacy policy at any time without prior notice. The current version published on our website shall apply.
datenschutz.contact_dpo_text: If you have any questions about data protection, please send us an e-mail or contact the person responsible for data protection listed at the beginning of this privacy policy.
